text: Hi Tessa! Marcus and I just paid the second installment. Can you confirm you got it?
Got it, thank you Hannah. Your October 17 date is fully booked on my side.
Perfect. We moved the ceremony to 4:30 so the light should be softer.
That is great news for portraits. Golden hour at Magnolia Hall starts around 6:40 in mid October.
Do you offer a second album for our parents?
Yes, parent albums start at 180 dollars for 8x8 with 20 spreads.
We will take two.
Wonderful, I will add them to the contract.
Can we do the first look at 3:15 by the oak courtyard?
Yes. I would suggest 3:15 for the first look and then 20 minutes with the wedding party before the ceremony.
Sounds good. My bridesmaids are getting ready at the Hotel Clermont if you want shots there.
I would love that. I can arrive at 1:00 for getting-ready details.
Here is the moodboard Marcus and I put together. We like film grain and warm tones.
This is really helpful. I will bring my 35mm primes and shoot a little warmer.
One more thing, my grandmother cannot walk far. Can we do her portraits near the ceremony space?
Of course. We will do her portraits first, right after the first look, and keep her seated.
Thank you, that means a lot to her.
I will add it to the timeline and send you a draft this week.
Draft timeline attached. Please check the family list for anything I missed.
Looks wonderful. We want to add one photo with Marcus's cousins from Savannah.
Also, are we okay to have sparklers at the exit?
Hey Tessa, we want to book an engagement session before the wedding. What do you have in October?
Hi Olivia! I have Saturday October 3 and Sunday October 11 open for engagement sessions.
October 3 works. Daniel is thinking the Atlanta BeltLine near Ponce City Market.
That is a great spot. Sunset is around 7:10 so we should start by 5:45.
Do you recommend a hair and makeup trial before the engagement shoot?
Not necessary, but it can help you feel confident. A light trial is plenty.
I will book a quick one.
Perfect.
Should we dress up or go casual?
Whatever you two feel most like yourselves in. I recommend one dressy and one casual outfit.
Daniel wants to wear his gray blazer. I am bringing a green dress.
Green will look amazing against the BeltLine murals.
Is it okay to bring Biscuit, our beagle?
Absolutely, dogs make the best engagement photos. Just bring a helper to hold the leash.
Ha, my sister will come along. Thanks!
Reminder that I will send the session guide and a short questionnaire this week.
Got it, thank you. We are really looking forward to it.
Here are the outfit options. Which one photographs better?
The green dress with the gray blazer. Both tones hold up well in warm light.
Perfect, done.
Hi Tessa, Arjun's family and mine would like a list of the ceremonies you will cover.
Hi Priyanka. I will cover the sangeet, the baraat, the ceremony and the reception on October 24.
We are also hosting a mehndi evening on the 22nd. Is it possible to add that?
Yes, I can add the mehndi evening for a three hour block. I will send the revised quote today.
Is it okay if the sangeet is shot mostly with available light? The hall is dim.
I will bring two portable LED panels and keep the look natural.
Perfect, thank you.
I will test the hall lighting the afternoon before.
Revised quote attached. It includes a second photographer for the baraat.
Thank you. My parents have a few must-have photos. Can I send you the list?
Please do. The more specific the better.
Here is the list: the milni, the pheras close-up, grandparents with the couple, and the cousins group shot.
Got it. I will plan the group shot right after the pheras while everyone is still gathered.
Great. The baraat starts at 2:00 sharp at the hotel entrance.
I will be there by 1:15 with my second shooter to get the groom's side arriving.
Quick question, can you shoot some drone photos at the Biltmore Ballroom exterior?
I do not fly drones, but my videographer friend Ben does. I can connect you two.
That would be wonderful.
One more request, my aunt from Chicago arrives on the 21st and wants to book a family portrait session.
Tessa, I am sending the vendor contact sheet for the Rowan-Pierce wedding tomorrow.
Perfect, Simone. I will confirm my arrival time at Magnolia Hall against your schedule.
The venue is giving us access to the courtyard at 2:30 only, so the first look will be tight.
That works. I will be ready with my lighting set at 2:45.
The caterer asked if photographers eat before or after the toasts.
After is best. I will eat during the first course of dinner.
Noted, I will pass that along.
Thank you.
Do you need a meal during the reception?
Yes please, the vendor meal is great. I will be on the dance floor most of the evening.
Noted. I will add you and Devon to the vendor list.
Heads up, the florist moved delivery to 1:00pm.
Thanks. I will plan detail shots of the bouquets right when they arrive.
Good plan. The bride wants pictures of the cake table too.
Another planner friend of mine is looking for a photographer for a November wedding. Can I refer her?
Please do. I have two dates left in November.
Perfect, I will send her your info.
Thanks for the referral. We booked a call for Friday.
Wonderful, I thought you two would click.
Hi Tessa, this is Beau from Petal & Stem. I will deliver the Rowan-Pierce arch flowers at 1:00.
Hi Beau, great. Could you leave the bridal bouquet in the bridal suite before then?
Yes, I will drop it off at noon so you can shoot details.
Could you share the palette so I can match my edit tones?
Sure. Mostly white ranunculus, blush garden roses, eucalyptus, and a few burnt orange dahlias.
Beautiful. I will make sure the dahlias pop.
Here is a photo of the test bouquet.
Love it. Thanks for the preview.
Is it okay if I take a couple of photos of the arrangements for my portfolio?
Of course, I will share the final gallery shots with you after delivery.
Appreciated.
Beau, can you also send the invoice for the photo credit page in the album?
Will do. Thanks again!
Hey Tessa, it is Rafael the DJ for the Rowan-Pierce reception. Do you have the last timeline?
Hi Rafael. I do, v3 from Simone. Grand entrance is 6:30, first dance at 6:50.
Perfect. I want to give you a heads up before the toasts so you can be ready on the floor.
That would help a lot. Can you cue me with a hand signal five minutes before the cake cutting?
Absolutely. I will also flash the lights during the bouquet toss.
Great, thanks.
Do you want a copy of the playlist? It helps me anticipate the dance floor moments.
Yes please. I like to know the song for the father-daughter dance.
Sending it now.
Question, can I have a few photos of me working for my site?
Absolutely. I will drop a few in your folder when I deliver the gallery.
Appreciate it, Tessa.
Also, can you confirm the sparkler exit time? Hannah asked about it.
Hi Tessa, this is Joanna at Magnolia Hall. Confirming your vendor load-in on October 17.
Hi Joanna, yes. I plan to arrive at 1:00 for getting-ready details.
Parking is behind the carriage house. Use the gate on Elm Street.
Is the courtyard available for portraits before the ceremony?
Yes, from 2:30 to 3:45. After that we set chairs.
Good. That covers the first look and wedding party portraits.
Do you need power for strobes?
Two outlets in the courtyard would help, but I can run battery-powered.
We have a GFCI outlet by the east wall. I will tag it for you.
One more thing, the venue has a no confetti policy, but sparklers are fine outdoors.
Thanks for flagging. I will let Hannah know.
Insurance certificate on file, thank you for sending it.
Of course. Let me know if you need anything else.
Tessa, Tom at Aldridge Albums. The proofs for the Whitaker album are ready for review.
Thanks Tom. Can you send the PDF?
Here you go. Layflat, 12x12, linen cover in slate gray.
The cover stamping looks too light. Can we go bolder?
Yes, we can do a deeper deboss. I will update the proof.
Great.
Updated proof attached. Also, you said you wanted two copies?
Yes, two copies plus a parent album, 8x8.
Noted. Turnaround is three weeks once approved.
Approved. Please ship to my studio address.
Shipped to your address on file. Tracking number ending in 4471.
Heads up, the new linen swatches arrived. Want me to send a sample kit?
Hey Tessa, I am free for second shooting on October 17 and the 24th.
Great, Devon. I would like you for both. Same rate as last time.
Perfect. Which cameras do you want me to bring?
Bring your 85mm and the 24-70. I will cover wide and details.
Can you send the mileage form for last month's wedding?
Yes, I will email it tonight.
Thanks, I will fill it out right away.
Appreciate it.
Do you want me with the groom at the getting-ready?
Yes. Be with Marcus from 1:00 to 3:00, then meet me at the courtyard.
Got it.
Quick note, I will have a short briefing on Thursday evening. Can you make it?
Yes, 7pm works for me.
Sorry to ask, but can I leave by 9:30 on the 24th? I have an early flight Sunday.
Yes, the reception program wraps by 9:00.
Thank you. I really appreciate it.
I will send you the shot list on Friday.
Sounds great, see you Thursday.
Tess! Are you coming to Mom's birthday dinner on Sunday?
Can you pick up the lemon cake from that bakery on Ponce?
On it.
Mom wants a family photo for the holiday card. Can you shoot it in October?
Sure, let us do it the first weekend after the Rowan wedding.
Perfect. I will pick outfits.
Keep them simple, solid colors.
Dad says hello, he is thinking of adopting a dog.
A dog! Wow. Tell him to start with a calm one.
Ha, I said the same.
Heads up, I will be shooting a wedding all weekend on the 17th, so I will miss brunch.
No worries. We will save you some leftovers.
Do you want to come to the fall festival in Decatur on the 25th?
I might be able to swing by after shooting that morning. Text me the time.
Will do.
Mom asked if you are free next weekend. She wants help with the garden.
Also, you left your lens cap at my place.
How was the engagement shoot on the BeltLine?
So good. The couple was so relaxed and the dog stole the show.
I love that. Want to grab dinner this week?
Yes. Thursday at 7?
Do you want to try that new pottery class on Saturday?
Yes! What time?
Eleven. I will book two spots.
Amazing, count me in.
Thursday works. Let us try the new ramen place on Peachtree.
Perfect, I will meet you there.
Bring your appetite.
I am so tired. Three weddings back to back.
You deserve a break. Let us plan a beach weekend in November.
Yes please. Savannah maybe?
Savannah sounds great. I will look at rentals.
Perfect, send me the dates when you find something.
Ha, no worries.
Found a place in Tybee for November 13 to 15.
Book it!
Hi, I found your work on Instagram. Are you available for a wedding on May 9, 2027?
Hi Gwen, thanks for reaching out. I have May 9 open. May I ask the location?
Piedmont Park, around 80 guests.
Gwen, I put together a pricing guide for your May date. Sending it now.
Thank you, I will review it with my fiance.
Take your time, let me know if you have questions.
That sounds lovely. My collections start at 3,200 dollars for eight hours of coverage.
That is within our budget. Do you offer a payment plan?
Yes, a 30 percent retainer and then three installments.
Great. Can we do a call this week?
Absolutely. Are you free Thursday at 4?
Yes, that works. Thanks!
Hi Tessa, I am Trevor. We are planning a small wedding on December 12 in Decatur.
Hi Trevor, congratulations. I have December 12 available.
We only need three hours of coverage, mostly ceremony and portraits. What would that cost?
A three hour elopement package is 1,450 dollars including an online gallery.
That sounds good. Can I see a sample gallery?
Sure, here is a sample from a recent elopement.
This is gorgeous. Let me talk to my fiance and get back to you.
Take your time. I will hold the date until Friday.
Thank you, we will confirm by then.
We would like to book. How do we start?
Hi Tessa, I finished the first batch of the Whitaker wedding edits. 480 photos so far.
Great, Camille. Can you send the gallery link?
Sent over email. I used your warm film preset.
Do you want the Whitaker wedding teaser images by Friday?
Yes, please send 15 favorites in a private link.
Sending Thursday night.
Perfect.
The skin tones look great. Can you soften the shadows a bit in the reception shots?
Sure, I will lift the shadows by 10 and reduce the vibrance.
Perfect.
Second batch is done. Do you want black and white versions of the portraits?
Yes, about 30 of my favorites. I will mark them.
Got it.
Can you take the next batch too? The Brandt engagement session is coming.
Yes, I have capacity for the first week of October.
Wonderful, I will send the files on the 4th.
Reminder, my invoice for September is attached.
Thanks, I will pay it this week.
Welcome everyone. This chat is for last-minute updates for the Rowan-Pierce wedding on October 17.
Thank you Simone! So excited.
Same here. Tessa, thank you for being flexible with the timeline.
Happy to help. Looking forward to October 17.
Our florist asked about the cake table location.
It will be by the east window of the reception hall.
Perfect, thanks.
My parents arrive Friday afternoon, by the way.
Reminder that the rehearsal is Friday October 16 at 5pm.
We will arrive at 4:30 with the programs.
I will join the rehearsal if that helps with shot planning.
Yes, Devon, please come.
Is it okay to bring a small flask for the toast with my groomsmen?
That is fine as long as it is out of the courtyard photos.
Of course.
My mom asked about hair and makeup times. Are we starting at 10?
Yes, hair at 10, makeup at 11:30.
Perfect. Tessa, you can arrive at 1:00 for details.
Final timeline attached, please review.
Looks perfect.
Love it.
Quick update, the string quartet needs an extra 15 minutes to load in.
Noted, I will adjust the courtyard hold.
Anyone want to split a styled shoot in October? Need two photographers and a videographer.
I am in. Theme?
Late autumn, moody florals, maybe at the Cheney Barn.
Count me in for video.
Who is going to the photo expo in Savannah next month?
I am registered. Anyone want to share a hotel room?
I will split a room, Mei.
I cannot make it, I have a wedding that weekend.
Reminder that the camera rental house is having a sale this weekend.
Thanks Lila. I need a new fast prime, I will check it out.
Did you see the new firmware update for the R5? Fixes the overheating issue.
Anyone have a lighting assistant they recommend for a big October wedding?
Camille is great for editing, and Lila has an assistant who is available.
Yes, I will send you his number.
Does anyone use a gimbal for ceremonies? I am torn between two models.
I use the DJI RS4, light and stable.
I just use a monopod, but video is not my specialty.
Collective dinner on the 12th at 8, anyone free?
I have a wedding that week but the 12th is free. Count me in.
Me too.
I will bring wine.
Perfect.
Happy Sunday everyone. Who is coming to dinner at 6?
I will be there with dessert.
Me too. I will grill.
I will bring the lemon cake.
Happy birthday to Dad in two weeks, any ideas?
He wants a new set of grilling tools.
I will chip in. Let us order together.
Great, I will send a link.
Paul, did you remember to call the electrician about the porch light?
Yes, he comes Tuesday.
Wonderful.
Anyone want to carpool to the Decatur festival?
I can drive. I have room for three.
I will meet you there.
I made a new recipe, sweet potato casserole. Come hungry.
You know I will.
Mom, no marshmallows this time please.
We will see.
Update on the dog. We are going to meet one at the shelter on Saturday.
Finally!
Send pictures.
Of course.
Welcome vendors. This chat is for October events at Magnolia Hall.
Thanks Joanna. Do we have a loading dock available?
Yes, behind the carriage house, accessible from Elm Street.
A reminder that the walkthrough for October events is Wednesday at 10.
I will be there.
Me too, I will bring sample centerpieces.
I will join by video if that works.
What time can I start setting up the ceremony arch on the 17th?
Any time after 11:30.
Perfect, I will plan for noon.
Do you have a preferred outlet for the DJ setup?
Plug into the east wall circuit. It is dedicated.
Thanks.
Reminder to everyone that quiet hours begin at 10pm.
Noted, thank you. I will wrap my last dance floor photos by then.
Appreciate everyone's cooperation.
The tent permit for the courtyard came through, so we can use it if it rains.
That is a relief. I will bring tent-friendly arrangements as a backup.
